description: Platform and framework profiles for offline-first app targeting. Values are engineering guidance distilled from public platform documentation; always verify exact minimums against your pinned SDK/toolchain, which is the only source of truth for your release. dependency_weight: low < 25 MB added footprint, moderate 25-250 MB, high > 250 MB (toolchain plus transitive dependencies).

profiles.name: Windows application target profile
profiles.min_os: Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045) or later for WinUI 3; Windows 10 1809+ for .NET; Windows 7+ unsupported for modern stacks
profiles.compatibility: WinUI 3 needs Windows App SDK; WPF/WinForms need .NET Desktop Runtime; C++ needs MSVC + Windows SDK
profiles.performance: Native C++/Rust-class; .NET with NativeAOT narrows startup gap; WPF/WinUI 3 are managed and fine for LOB apps
profiles.accessibility: UI Automation (UIA) is the contract; WinUI 3 and WPF expose it by default; test with Inspect.exe/Narrator
profiles.distribution_constraints: MSIX via Microsoft Store or sideloading, signed MSI/Win32, or enterprise MDM; signing required for SmartScreen trust
profiles.escape_paths: P/Invoke, C++/WinRT, COM, Win32 API for anything the framework cannot express
profiles.offline_notes: Windows SDK, MSVC, and NuGet caches are routinely vendored for offline restore; symbol packages large but cacheable

profiles.name: macOS application target profile
profiles.min_os: macOS 13 Ventura or later recommended; SwiftUI floor typically macOS 12+
profiles.dependency_weight: moderate (Xcode + SDKs large; app payloads small)
profiles.compatibility: Xcode pinned per macOS; Swift/SwiftUI, Objective-C, or Qt/Electron/Tauri payloads
profiles.performance: Native Swift/Obj-C optimal; universal binaries add size; Rosetta 2 is a migration aid, not a target
profiles.accessibility: NSAccessibility protocol; test with Accessibility Inspector and VoiceOver; honor reduce-motion and contrast
profiles.distribution_constraints: Developer ID signing + notarization for direct distribution; Mac App Store sandbox stricter
profiles.escape_paths: Objective-C runtime, C interop, Metal/AppKit for unsupported regions
profiles.offline_notes: Xcode .xip, SDKs, and Swift package caches are mirrorable; notarization requires connectivity at release time only

profiles.name: Linux application target profile
profiles.min_os: glibc 2.28+ (Debian 10/Ubuntu 18.04 floor) for AppImage; distro-specific for deb/rpm; musl for Alpine
profiles.compatibility: GTK4 or Qt 6 preferred; X11 and Wayland both must be tested; packaging differs per format
profiles.performance: Native-class; GTK/Qt startup fast; Electron heavy - measure cold start explicitly
profiles.accessibility: AT-SPI / ATK bus; Orca screen reader; verify focus order and roles; honor high-contrast and font scaling
profiles.distribution_constraints: AppImage/Flatpak/deb/rpm/pacman; no central notarization; distro repos have their own review and pinning
profiles.escape_paths: Direct syscalls, D-Bus, distro-specific helper binaries (pkexec) for privileged actions
profiles.offline_notes: Apt/dnf/pacman caches and Flatpak remotes are mirrorable; AppImage toolchain fully vendorable

profiles.name: Android application target profile
profiles.min_os: API 26 (Android 8.0) pragmatic floor; API 24 for wider reach with androidx; targetSdk per Play policy
profiles.dependency_weight: high (SDK licenses + emulator images; Gradle caches large)
profiles.compatibility: Jetpack Compose or Views; Play Services optional - prefer AOSP APIs for offline/enterprise
profiles.performance: Baseline profiles + R8 shrinking matter; startup < 200 ms cold on mid-tier is achievable with discipline
profiles.accessibility: TalkBack + Switch Access; Compose semantics tree; test with accessibility scanner and font scale to 200%
profiles.distribution_constraints: Play Store (targetSdk policy, AAB, signing by Google Play recommended) or direct APK signing for enterprise/FOSS
profiles.escape_paths: JNI/NDK, reflection (bounded), AppWidgets, foreground services for background work
profiles.offline_notes: SDK platform images, NDK, and Gradle dependency cache all vendorable; license acceptance recorded in sdkmanager --licenses

profiles.name: iOS application target profile
profiles.min_os: iOS 16 or later for SwiftUI feature completeness; iOS 15 floor for most UIKit codebases
profiles.dependency_weight: high (Xcode requirement; toolchains not redistributable cross-platform)
profiles.compatibility: Xcode-pinned Swift/SwiftUI or UIKit; macOS build host mandatory; device farm for real hardware
profiles.performance: Native; SwiftUI performance fine for typical apps; profile scrolling and launch with Instruments
profiles.accessibility: VoiceOver; accessibilityLabel/trait/value on Compose-analog Views; Dynamic Type to accessibility-XXL is mandatory-quality
profiles.distribution_constraints: App Store (review, privacy manifest, notarization not applicable); TestFlight; enterprise via Apple Business Manager; ad hoc/dev-signed for internal
profiles.escape_paths: Objective-C runtime, C/C++ interop, UIKit interop from SwiftUI for unsupported controls
profiles.offline_notes: Xcode and SPM caches mirrorable on macOS; App Store Connect access needed only at submission time

profiles.name: Flutter framework selection
profiles.min_os: Follows host OS: Android API 21+, iOS 12+, Windows 10 1809+, macOS 10.14+, Linux glibc 2.28+
profiles.dependency_weight: high (Flutter SDK + engine artifacts; pub cache mirrorable)
profiles.compatibility: Dart single codebase; platform channels for native APIs; Impeller renderer defaults on mobile
profiles.performance: Compiled AOT on device; 60/120 fps achievable; watch jank from shader compilation - warm up or use Impeller
profiles.accessibility: Semantics widget; TalkBack/VoiceOver/UIA via engine; audit with flutter test semantics and platform scans
profiles.distribution_constraints: Per-platform stores; single binary per platform; engine pinned to Flutter release - no ad hoc drift
profiles.escape_paths: Platform channels to Kotlin/Swift/C++; FFI for native libs; Add-to-App for incremental adoption
profiles.offline_notes: flutter pub via hosted mirror or path/git deps on vendored repos; gradle/xcode caches as per platform

profiles.name: React Native framework selection
profiles.min_os: Android API 24+, iOS 15+ recommended; Windows via RNW targets Windows 10+
profiles.dependency_weight: high (node_modules + two native toolchains; Metro caches)
profiles.compatibility: New architecture (Fabric/TurboModules) preferred; Hermes engine default; Expo optional but reduces native control
profiles.performance: Bridgeless new arch narrows gap vs native; avoid large unserializable payloads across the boundary
profiles.accessibility: accessibilityRole/Label/State props map to platform a11y; test both TalkBack and VoiceOver; also RNW with UIA
profiles.distribution_constraints: Per-platform stores; OTA updates via CodePush-like services require care with store policy on JS-only bundles
profiles.escape_paths: Native modules in Kotlin/Swift/Obj-C/C++; TurboModules/JSI for performance-critical paths
profiles.offline_notes: npm registry mirror (verdaccio or offline cache), Gradle + CocoaPods/SPM caches vendored together; lockfiles mandatory

profiles.name: .NET MAUI framework selection
profiles.dependency_weight: high (workloads per platform; NuGet cache large)
profiles.compatibility: Single C# codebase; Handlers replace Renderers; WinUI 3 underneath on Windows, Catalyst on macOS
profiles.performance: Compiled; startup dominated by runtime init - AOT/trimming for store builds; measure per platform
profiles.accessibility: SemanticProperties map to UIA/VoiceOver/TalkBack; needs explicit work - not automatic for custom handlers
profiles.distribution_constraints: Per-platform stores; Windows via MSIX; single project produces all targets - CI matrix essential
profiles.escape_paths: Custom Handlers to native views; P/Invoke; platform-specific projects in multi-target solutions
profiles.offline_notes: dotnet workload packs and NuGet caches fully vendorable; wasm targets need matching runtime cache

profiles.name: Qt framework selection
profiles.dependency_weight: high (Qt modules + Creator; licenses matter: LGPL vs Commercial)
profiles.compatibility: C++ or QML; Qt Widgets mature; Qt Quick for fluid UIs; check LTS version policy for your support window
profiles.performance: Excellent; scene-graph rendering; static linking possible under LGPL with obligations or commercial license
profiles.accessibility: Qt Accessible API implemented per platform backend; verify with platform tools, not only Qt's own checks
profiles.distribution_constraints: Commercial or LGPL compliance (relinking clause); static vs dynamic deployment is a legal decision
profiles.escape_paths: Full C++ native access; platform plugins; direct Win32/Cocoa/X11 calls when the framework is in the way
profiles.offline_notes: Qt installer archives and offline repositories (repository-style) are the supported air-gap route

profiles.name: Tauri framework selection
profiles.min_os: Windows 10+ (WebView2, evergreen - may require bootstrapper), macOS 10.15+, glibc 2.28+ with webkit2gtk
profiles.dependency_weight: low to moderate (Rust toolchain + system webview; small binaries)
profiles.compatibility: Rust core + system webview; frontend of your choice; WebView2 runtime presence is the main Windows gotcha
profiles.performance: Near-native startup; memory a fraction of Electron; webview consistency across hosts is the risk
profiles.accessibility: Inherits system webview a11y tree; audit with platform tools; keyboard focus in webview needs explicit tests
profiles.distribution_constraints: MSI/NSIS, DMG, AppImage/deb; Tauri updater signs bundles - manage the update signing key carefully
profiles.escape_paths: Full Rust core plugins; invoke() bridge; native webview injection for last-resort fixes
profiles.offline_notes: crates.io vendored registry or vendor/ directory; npm mirror for frontend; WebView2 runtime must itself be bootstrapped offline or via evergreen channel

profiles.name: Electron framework selection
profiles.compatibility: Chromium consistency guaranteed; Node integration - treat web content as hostile, sandbox renderers
profiles.performance: Heaviest option; startup and memory must be measured and budgeted; lazy-load modules aggressively
profiles.accessibility: Chromium a11y tree maps to UIA/NSAccessibility/AT-SPI; audit with axe + platform tools; focus management is on you
profiles.distribution_constraints: electron-builder/forge; auto-update needs signed artifacts (Squirrel/nsis); store acceptance is limited but possible (Mac App Store, MS Store)
profiles.escape_paths: Main-process Node APIs; native node modules (node-gyp - toolchain pinning critical); contextBridge for typed exposure
profiles.offline_notes: electron binary zip + npm mirror required; node-gyp headers must be vendored; runtime downloads are a common offline failure

profiles.name: SwiftUI stack profile
profiles.min_os: iOS 16 / macOS 13 for current feature set; iOS 17+ for @Observable and richer previews
profiles.dependency_weight: low for system apps beyond Xcode itself
profiles.compatibility: Apple platforms only; UIKit/AppKit interop for gaps; Xcode-pinned toolchain
profiles.performance: Excellent when avoiding over-diffing; large lists need LazyVStack discipline; Instruments first, guessing never
profiles.accessibility: Best-in-class with .accessibility* modifiers; Dynamic Type + VoiceOver are first-class; test on hardware
profiles.distribution_constraints: App Store / notarized DMG only; sandbox for store builds; privacy manifests required
profiles.offline_notes: Xcode + SPM caches vendorable on macOS; no Linux/Windows build host

profiles.name: Jetpack Compose stack profile
profiles.min_os: Android API 21+ (Compose supports 21+); Wear OS and TV variants exist
profiles.dependency_weight: high (Android toolchain); moderate inside the app module
profiles.compatibility: Android-only (Desktop/JVM variants exist for tooling, not consumer delivery parity)
profiles.performance: Baseline profiles + strong Skipping mode; stability annotations for recomposition control
profiles.accessibility: semantics tree; mergingDescendants; 200% font scale and TalkBack on physical devices
profiles.distribution_constraints: Play Store/AAB or direct APK; no iOS path - Compose Multiplatform is a different product decision
profiles.escape_paths: AndroidView to View system; Compose interop with legacy; NDK for native
profiles.offline_notes: Gradle + SDK + Compose compiler plugin all cacheable; offline first-run build is a standard gate

profiles.name: Kotlin Multiplatform stack profile
profiles.min_os: Android API 24+, iOS 15+, plus JVM/native targets per KMP version
profiles.dependency_weight: high (two toolchains; Gradle KMP plugin complex)
profiles.compatibility: Shared Kotlin for logic; UI via Compose Multiplatform or platform-native (SwiftUI/Compose) UIs
profiles.performance: Native for logic; UI layer native-speed on each platform; binary size overhead from Kotlin runtime
profiles.accessibility: Delegated to the UI layer chosen per platform - inherit that platform profile's obligations
profiles.distribution_constraints: Per-platform stores; KMP shared module published internally via Maven local/composite builds
profiles.escape_paths: expect/actual declarations; direct Obj-C/Swift and JVM interop for platform calls
profiles.offline_notes: Gradle caches, Kotlin/Native compiler, and CocoaPods/SPM all need mirroring; konan cache is sizeable

profiles.name: Avalonia UI framework selection
profiles.min_os: Windows 10+, macOS 10.15+, glibc 2.23+ X11/Wayland, iOS/Android experimental
profiles.dependency_weight: moderate (NuGet packages; self-contained .NET publish large but predictable)
profiles.performance: Good; Skia GPU usage consistent across platforms; large data grids need virtualization discipline
profiles.accessibility: AutomationPeer support with UIA/AT-SPI backends; verify on Linux with Orca - Linux a11y is the weakest backend today
profiles.distribution_constraints: Per-platform packaging (MSIX/DMG/AppImage/deb); no store lock-in; self-contained vs framework-dependent is the size/footprint dial
profiles.escape_paths: Full .NET interop; native window handles; platform-specific projects in the same solution
profiles.offline_notes: NuGet cache plus Skia native assets via NuGet - fully vendorable; no runtime downloads on first run

profiles.name: Uno Platform framework selection
profiles.min_os: Windows 10+ (WinUI target), iOS 15+, Android API 24+, WebAssembly for browser, glibc 2.28+ Linux
profiles.dependency_weight: high (workloads + wasm tooling for web target)
profiles.compatibility: WinUI API surface reused across targets; WebAssembly/Skia rendering engines; mobile targets via Skia or native heads
profiles.performance: Native targets fine; WASM startup bounded by dotnet runtime download - host it locally for offline
profiles.accessibility: AutomationPeer/UIA on Windows; other backends require manual verification per target
profiles.distribution_constraints: Per-store on mobile; web target is a static site (self-host or CDN) - simplest distribution but browser IS the platform
profiles.escape_paths: Partial classes per platform head; P/Invoke; direct native project references
profiles.offline_notes: Syncfusion-free core is plain NuGet; wasm AOT toolchain large but cacheable; verify wasm assets ship locally, not from a CDN

profiles.name: ARM64 target profile
profiles.dependency_weight: n/a (cross-cutting); x64 emulators are NOT ARM64 verification
profiles.compatibility: Native on Apple Silicon, modern Android, Windows on ARM, Linux aarch64 servers/boards
profiles.performance: Often better performance-per-watt; verify native dependencies ship arm64 slices/objects - one missing transitive .so defeats the build
profiles.distribution_constraints: Universal binaries (macOS) include x64 slice; Android App Bundles deliver per-ABI; Windows MSIX publishes per-arch
profiles.escape_paths: n/a - universal binary planning and fat packaging is the control point
profiles.offline_notes: Mirror every native dependency per-ABI; emulator images for arm64 vs host-arch are frequently confused

profiles.name: x64 target profile
profiles.compatibility: Universal desktop baseline: all desktop OSes; legacy x86 32-bit largely legacy-only
profiles.performance: Excellent on desktop/server; on ARM hosts it runs translated - always verify on real ARM hardware before sign-off
profiles.distribution_constraints: Default slice for Windows/Linux; macOS new software should ship universal (arm64+x64)
profiles.escape_paths: n/a - choose universal binary when both ARM and x64 fleets must be served
profiles.offline_notes: Simplest ABI to mirror; still verify every vendored native artifact advertises x64

profiles.name: Cross-platform application target profile
profiles.min_os: Effective floor = strictest target in the selected set; document it explicitly
profiles.dependency_weight: high by definition - you are carrying every target's toolchain
profiles.compatibility: Choose ONE primary abstraction (framework) plus per-platform escape hatches; do not fork logic per platform
profiles.performance: Lowest common denominator risk; budget measurement per platform, not once
profiles.accessibility: Test per platform with native tools; a11y bugs rarely reproduce identically across engines
profiles.distribution_constraints: N stores/packages to satisfy; signing identities N ways; release orchestration is the bottleneck
profiles.escape_paths: Per-framework escape hatch (see selected framework profile); keep the shared core portable
profiles.offline_notes: Mirror every platform's caches in one bundle; CI must restore all of them before any build
